reading_guide.program-step: Top-level Perelman program claim. Never a proved theorem; status blocked/planned.
reading_guide.interface-node: Checked definition/lemma/structure of the D1 interface layer, or an open interface.
reading_guide.checked-result: Kernel-checked theorem/lemma cluster with a compiling file and axiom cone. `proved: true` means every referenced declaration resolves and compiles; a referenced declaration that is a statement-only Prop (for example an `...Interface` or `...Statement`) is identified in the claim text/note and also appears in the blocked layer. It does not mean the cluster proves the corresponding Perelman step.
reading_guide.blocked-layer: Explicit unproved Prop, missing theorem, or documented boundary.
reading_guide.evidence: Every declaration is resolved against the D6 kernel audit (logs/13_d6_decl_report.log); axiom cones are subsets of {propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound}.

interface_nodes.statement: A charted space M with model (E, H, I); mathlib tangent spaces TangentSpace I x are used throughout.
A one-parameter family of Riemannian metrics g : R -> RiemannianMetric (fun x => TangentSpace I x).
assumptions: mathlib Bundle.RiemannianMetric on the tangent bundle

interface_nodes.statement: The Ricci tensor as a pointwise symmetric bilinear form on each tangent space; Ric : R -> (x : M) -> TangentSpace I x ->L[R] TangentSpace I x ->L[R] R.
assumptions: no mathlib Ricci tensor exists; this is data
blockers: mathlib v4.34.0-rc2 has no Riemann or Ricci curvature tensor; the object is carried as data and its symmetry is a field

interface_nodes.statement: Pointwise time derivative of a metric family: for all x, v, w, s |-> g s (v,w) has derivative dg x v w at t.
The bilinear form -2 Ric appearing on the right-hand side of the Ricci-flow equation.

Candidate Ricci flow: a time interval T containing 0 and OrdConnected, a metric family g, an abstract Ricci tensor Ric, plus explicit hypotheses: time-smooth metric coefficients, Ric symmetric, and the pointwise equation d/dt g = -2 Ric on T.
assumptions: timeDomain : Set R with 0 in it and OrdConnected
metric_time_smooth : ContDiff R top of every scalar coefficient
ricciFlow_equation : HasMetricTimeDerivative metric (negTwoRicci Ric) t for t in T
blockers: no smooth structure on the space of Riemannian metrics; smoothness in the space variable is not formalized
no existence theorem for the flow (Hamilton short-time existence) is provided or asserted

interface_nodes.statement: For s, t in the time domain, the whole interval Icc s t is contained in the time domain.
The Gram matrix (g x (b i) (b j)) of a metric g in a basis b of the tangent space at x.
assumptions: basis b : Basis (Fin n) R (TangentSpace I x)

interface_nodes.statement: The classical local volume density sqrt(det(gramMatrix g x b)) of a Riemannian metric in a basis.
assumptions: basis b : Basis (Fin n) R (TangentSpace I x)
blockers: no global Riemannian volume form in mathlib; the density is local and frame-dependent

interface_nodes.statement: A predicate parameter IsRiemannianVolumeOf : R -> MetricFamily I M -> Measure M -> Prop; consumers instantiate it with their notion of Riemannian volume.
blockers: mathlib has no Riemannian volume form, so the property cannot be defined from first principles yet

interface_nodes.statement: Concrete frame-based instance of the volume predicate: mu has density sqrt(det g) with respect to a reference measure mu0 in a global frame.
assumptions: global frame (x : M) -> Basis (Fin n) R (TangentSpace I x)
blockers: a global frame need not exist; the global volume form requires a partition-of-unity gluing argument

interface_nodes.statement: Time-dependent volume data: a measure family together with explicit hypotheses that it is the Riemannian volume of the flow, locally finite, and non-zero.
assumptions: is_riemannian_volume : for t in T, IsRiemannianVolumeOf t flow.metric (volume t)
blockers: Riemannian volume form not in mathlib; predicate is a parameter

interface_nodes.statement: Scalar curvature trace formula R = sum_{i,j} g^{ij} Ric_{ij} in a basis of the tangent space.
assumptions: basis b : Basis (Fin n) R (TangentSpace I x)

interface_nodes.statement: R is the scalar curvature of Ric for g if R t x equals the trace formula in every basis; basis-independence is built into the statement.
blockers: basis-independence is a hypothesis, not proved from a change-of-basis computation

interface_nodes.statement: Scalar curvature data for a metric flow: scalar : R -> M -> R with the explicit trace hypothesis and spatial continuity.
blockers: the trace of the abstract Ricci tensor is not proved to exist; it is data satisfying the formula

interface_nodes.statement: F(mu, R, |grad f|^2, f) = integral of (R + |grad f|^2) e^{-f} d mu, as a Bochner integral.
blockers: finiteness/integrability of the integral is not asserted and must be a hypothesis in monotonicity theorems

interface_nodes.statement: W(mu, n, tau, R, |grad f|^2, f) = integral of [tau(|grad f|^2 + R) + f - n] (4 pi tau)^{-n/2} e^{-f} d mu.
blockers: the exponent -n/2 and the normalization (4 pi tau)^{-n/2} are formalized as Real.rpow; positivity of tau is a hypothesis, not a convention

interface_nodes.statement: Admissibility constraint for mu: integral of (4 pi tau)^{-n/2} e^{-f} d mu = 1.
mu(W) = sInf (range W), the infimum of a W-profile; no minimizer existence is asserted.
blockers: attainment of the infimum requires a compactness/coercivity theorem

interface_nodes.statement: The time profile t |-> F(g(t), f(t)) of the F-functional.
The time profile t |-> W(g(t), f(t), tau(t)) of the W-functional.
Coordinate derivative d_i f = mfderiv I (model on R) f x (b i) in a basis direction.
assumptions: basis b : Basis (Fin n) R (TangentSpace I x)

interface_nodes.statement: |grad f|^2 = sum_{i,j} g^{ij} d_i f d_j f in a basis.
assumptions: basis b : Basis (Fin n) R (TangentSpace I x)
blockers: basis-independence of the gradient norm and its identification with the metric dual of the differential are not proved

interface_nodes.statement: Hypothesis structure: the F-profile is AntitoneOn the flow time domain.
blockers: Perelman's actual monotonicity theorem is not proved; it is this hypothesis

interface_nodes.statement: Hypothesis structure: the W-profile is AntitoneOn the flow time domain.
blockers: Perelman's actual W-monotonicity theorem is not proved; it is this hypothesis

interface_nodes.statement: Hypothesis structure: mu is MonotoneOn a scale domain J.
blockers: monotonicity of mu in tau is a hypothesis

interface_nodes.statement: Hypothesis structure: R >= c at every time and point along the flow.
assumptions: lower_bound : forall t in T, forall x, c <= scalar t x

interface_nodes.statement: Hypothesis structure: Ric(v,v) >= kappa g(v,v) at every time, point and tangent vector.
assumptions: lower_bound : forall t in T, x, v, kappa * g v v <= Ric v v

interface_nodes.statement: |Rm t y| <= K for all y in a set s; a scalar curvature-bound predicate.
blockers: Rm is a scalar stand-in for the full Riemann tensor norm

interface_nodes.statement: kappa-non-collapsing at scale r0: kappa > 0, r0 > 0, and if |Rm| <= r^{-2} on a ball of radius r <= r0 then Vol(ball) >= kappa r^n.
blockers: no proof of no-local-collapsing; the statement is a hypothesis structure
the curvature bound is a scalar |Rm| bound, not the full tensor norm

interface_nodes.statement: Finite model of F: sum over a finite type of (R x + |grad f|^2 x) e^{-f x} w x.
If w >= 0 and R <= R' pointwise then toyF w R gradSq f <= toyF w R' gradSq f.
assumptions: hR : forall x, R x <= R' x
interface_nodes.source: toy analogue of the elementary part of F-monotonicity

interface_nodes.statement: Finite model of W: sum of (tau (|grad f|^2 + R) + f - n) e^{-f} w.
If w >= 0 and every bracket tau(|grad f|^2 + R) + f - n >= 0 pointwise then toyW >= 0.
assumptions: hterm : forall x, 0 <= tau (|grad f|^2 + R) + f - n
interface_nodes.source: toy analogue of the elementary lower bound for W

interface_nodes.statement: If range W is bounded below then perelmanMu W <= W f for every f.
A constant metric family has zero time derivative in the sense of HasMetricTimeDerivative.
assumptions: g : RiemannianMetric on the tangent bundle

interface_nodes.statement: A constant metric family with zero Ricci tensor satisfies the pointwise Ricci-flow equation.
assumptions: g : RiemannianMetric on the tangent bundle

interface_nodes.statement: Given a metric, an interval containing 0, the constant family with zero Ricci tensor is a term of MetricFlowData; this shows the interface is inhabited without asserting a Ricci flow exists.
The Riemannian volume density sqrt(det g) is non-negative.
If the Gram matrix is positive definite then sqrt(det g) > 0.
blockers: unconditional positivity needs a proof that the Gram matrix of a Riemannian metric in a basis is PosDef

interface_nodes.statement: The three monotonicity hypothesis structures transfer to ordered pairs of times/scales in their domains.
Each monotonicity structure is exactly the AntitoneOn statement it records; the interface adds no content.
CurvatureBoundedOn is monotone in the bound K.
assumptions: h : CurvatureBoundedOn Rm t K s

checked_results.claim: Finite-dimensional curvature-tensor algebra probe: skew-symmetry, Bianchi, Ricci trace and additivity are kernel-checked.
checked_results.note: Probe only: mathlib has no Riemann curvature tensor (blocker U1).

checked_results.claim: Levi-Civita uniqueness and torsion antisymmetry toy probes are kernel-checked.
Discrete heat-slab maximum-principle probe and affine heat-slab interface are kernel-checked; the continuous interface is statement-only.
checked_results.note: HeatSlabMaximumPrincipleInterface is an unproved Prop (blocker U6/I2).

checked_results.claim: Perelman F/W/mu interfaces are defined and the toy monotonicity lemmas are kernel-checked.
checked_results.note: The F/W/mu monotonicity structures are hypotheses, not proved theorems (blockers U12).

checked_results.claim: Abstract connection curvature identities: skew, Bianchi, cyclic decomposition, Ricci additivity, scalar additivity/scaling and the basis trace formula.
checked_results.note: Algebraic identities over abstract data; not differential-geometric curvature of a manifold.

checked_results.claim: Levi-Civita uniqueness and metric-compatibility equivalence are kernel-checked; existence and covariant-derivative curvature are explicit unproved Props.
checked_results.note: LeviCivitaExistenceStatement and CovariantDerivativeCurvatureStatement are BLOCKED Props (blocker I1).

checked_results.claim: Discrete maximum principle on a finite heat grid: the evolution never exceeds the initial supremum and the discrete energy is non-increasing.
checked_results.note: Finite-grid content only; ContinuousHeatMaximumPrincipleInterface is statement-only (blocker I2).

checked_results.claim: The non-negative orthant is invariant under the finite-dimensional Hamilton reaction ODE (continuous and explicit-Euler discrete).
The scalar curvature functional of the finite-dimensional reaction ODE is monotone (continuous and discrete).
checked_results.note: scalarCurvature_monotone_of_bridge is conditional on the uninhabited TensorRicciFlowODEBridge (blocker I3).

checked_results.claim: Entropy interface: F/W data, monotonicity and decay certificates, their composition and the discrete heat-energy certificate are kernel-checked; all analytic inputs are explicit hypotheses.
checked_results.note: No Perelman entropy monotonicity: FDerivativeStatement, WeightedIBPStatement, BochnerStatement, ConjugateMeasureEvolutionStatement and EntropyFunctionalRegularityStatement are unproved Props (blocker I4).

checked_results.claim: Compact 3-manifold class yields the expected topological consequences (sigma-compact, paracompact, locally compact, second countable, finite chart cover).
kappa-noncollapsing certificate algebra and its equivalence with the normalized-ball-volume lower bound are kernel-checked.
checked_results.note: The non-collapsing theorem itself (K1-K7) is statement-only (blocker I5).

checked_results.claim: Surgery ledger interface: datum/predicates/certificate constructors and chain composition preserve the ledger invariants.
checked_results.note: NeckAnalysis, ExtinctionTheorem and MissingInputs are statement-only (blocker I6); orientability is a parameter (U11).

checked_results.claim: Toy extinction skeleton: the toy complexity relation strictly decreases and admits no infinite chain.
checked_results.note: Toy relation only; it models the decreasing part of extinction, not a geometric neck surgery.

checked_results.claim: Finite Gibbs-weighted functional perelmanF is antitone along the D2 evolution relation (continuous and discrete), with an explicit dissipation identity.
checked_results.note: NOT Perelman F-monotonicity: finite sum, c is abstract data, FDissipation = 0, sign convention opposite to Perelman's F (blockers A2/I7).

checked_results.claim: D3 antitone certificates are instantiated for the evolution cluster (continuous and discrete).
checked_results.note: Transfer theorems are conditional on uninhabited interfaces (blocker I8).

checked_results.claim: Adversarial audit found no false statement; three promoted theorems have overstrong hypotheses and sharp-hypothesis replacements are kernel-checked.
checked_results.note: Blocker A1: upstream restatement recommended; corrected declarations live in D4Audit.

checked_results.claim: Counterexamples delimit the hypotheses of the D4 cluster and non-vacuity checks confirm the main theorem is not vacuous.
checked_results.note: Audit scope covers the D4 evolution cluster only (blocker A3).

blocked_layer.reason: abstract Levi-Civita existence is false without an invariant-metric hypothesis; smooth-manifold existence in mathlib is for CovariantDerivative, not this algebraic setting
mathlib has no CovariantDerivative.curvature (D1 card: #check_failure RiemannCurvatureTensor)
pinned mathlib has no heat-equation theory, heat kernel, or parabolic PDE layer; the continuous implication cannot be proved here
Spatial Laplacian of the curvature evolution is not modeled (mathlib has no tensor Laplacian); exposed as the explicit DiffusionVanishes hypothesis of TensorRicciFlowODEBridge.
Manifold curvature API missing (CovariantDerivativeCurvatureStatement, geometry cluster); exposed as the explicit ManifoldCurvatureRealization conjunct of TensorRicciFlowODERealization.
No inhabitant of TensorRicciFlowODEBridge is constructed; the bridge is an explicit interface, never an axiom.
FDerivativeStatement (differentiation under the integral sign / first variation of F) is an unproved Prop.
WeightedIBPStatement and BochnerStatement are unproved Props; the pinned mathlib has no Riemannian geometry API (D1 card).
ConjugateMeasureEvolutionStatement is an unproved Prop; the pinned mathlib has no heat-equation theory (D2 card).
EntropyFunctionalRegularityStatement (C^1 regularity of the functional) is an unproved Prop.
The one-sided bound fields (upper_le / lower_le) are explicit hypotheses, not derived.
WeightedCalculus is abstract data; no smooth manifold or metric is constructed.
